Brazil at the 1998 FIFA World Cup | At the 1998 FIFA World Cup, Brazil participated for the 16th time in the event.  The country remained as the only national team to have participated in every installment of the FIFA World Cup.  Brazil reached the final where they were defeated 3–0 by France.
2017 FIFA Club World Cup | The 2017 FIFA Club World Cup (officially known as the FIFA Club World Cup UAE 2017 presented by Alibaba YunOS Auto for sponsorship reasons) will be the 14th edition of the FIFA Club World Cup, a FIFA-organised international club football tournament between the champion clubs from each of the six continental confederations, as well as the national league champion from the host country.  The tournament will be hosted by the United Arab Emirates.
2018 FIFA Club World Cup | The 2018 FIFA Club World Cup (officially known as the FIFA Club World Cup UAE 2018 presented by Alibaba YunOS Auto for sponsorship reasons) will be the 15th edition of the FIFA Club World Cup, a FIFA-organised international club football tournament between the champion clubs from each of the six continental confederations, as well as the national league champion from the host country.  The tournament will be hosted by the United Arab Emirates.
2013 FIFA Club World Cup | The 2013 FIFA Club World Cup (officially known as the FIFA Club World Cup Morocco 2013 presented by Toyota for sponsorship reasons) was the 10th edition of the FIFA Club World Cup, a FIFA-organised international club football tournament between the champion clubs from each of the six continental confederations, as well as the national league champion from the host country.  It was hosted by Morocco, and played from 11 to 21 December 2013.
2015 FIFA Club World Cup | The 2015 FIFA Club World Cup (officially known as the FIFA Club World Cup Japan 2015 presented by Alibaba E-Auto for sponsorship reasons) was the 12th edition of the FIFA Club World Cup, a FIFA-organised international club football tournament between the champion clubs from each of the six continental confederations, as well as the national league champion from the host country.  The tournament was hosted by Japan between 10–20 December 2015.
